script.text: A well-played duel, Chazz, but not well enough.
Pure luck! You drew a lucky card and stumbled into the win. That’s all!
Perhaps. But luck favors the prepared, and I was prepared to beat you with a half dozen other cards as well. Sorry, you would have lost one way or another.
Chazz. You stole, you lied, you cheated and you lost. You deserve to be demoted.
